name: denn-rebuild
description: DENN PRODUCTS rebuild monorepo scaffold (spec 010). Minimal skeleton only — no product features, no Firebase SDK/connection, no deploy.

scripts.format:check: biome format apps packages tests scripts vitest.config.ts vitest.live.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.lint: biome lint --error-on-warnings apps packages tests scripts vitest.config.ts vitest.live.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/firebase/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/spaces/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/render/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mockup/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: vite build apps/mockup && vite build apps/admin
